title: Keyboard S cannot close the settings panel while a pipe is selected
detail: Collection is gated on sel_pipe < 0, so with a selected pipe the panel-open S/Esc branch never sees S; the advertised primary close key is dead in that state.
recommended_fix: Collect S also when inp.panel_open (panel-open branch consumes it before Set_Lane), e.g. `if inp.sel_pipe < 0 || inp.panel_open`.

title: a11y chip text ignores reduced_motion, contradicting its own 'scaled' branch
detail: settings_chip_rect selects the compact 'scaled' text when reduced_motion is on, but a11y_chip_text never mentions motion — a reduced-motion-only player sees no active-mode summary.
recommended_fix: Add a reduced-motion arm to a11y_chip_text (e.g. "A11Y: MOTION") when only v.reduced_motion is active.

title: crisis_card_width clamp can still exceed the forecast-clearing maximum on narrow windows
detail: If max_card < hud(240) (small win_w), the max() silently violates the clamp and the banner again crosses the forecast panel — the exact B4 failure.
recommended_fix: Clamp the window instead (or widen the gap/shrink text), and document/assert the 240px minimum is unreachable at supported window sizes.

title: tmp_settings_path takes an unused testing.T parameter
evidence:
tmp_settings_path :: proc(t: ^testing.T) -> string {
	// Perkins r6 blocker 1: macOS returns IDENTICAL nanosecond values ...
detail: The parameter t is never read in the body; every caller passes it pointlessly. Suggests an aborted design.
recommended_fix: Drop the parameter (or use it to name the fixture) — pure signature hygiene.

title: hud_zero_scale test never calls view_compute; the real guard is untested
detail: The test name promises view_compute coverage but the guard is copy-pasted inline, so deleting the real guard in view.odin still passes CI green.
recommended_fix: Call the actual view_compute (it needs a Balance — construct a minimal one) instead of emulating the guard.

title: Input.panel_row comment references nonexistent SETTINGS_ROWS constant
evidence:
panel_open: bool,
	panel_row:  i32, // the focused settings row (0..SETTINGS_ROWS-1)
detail: The actual constant is SETTINGS_ROW_COUNT (render/settings_panel.odin); the comment cites a name that does not exist anywhere in the diff.

title: Mouse press path splits into two consecutive 'if ui' blocks, one empty
detail: Back-to-back `if ui` / `if ui {} else if` is redundant and fragile — the empty first branch of the second if exists only to anchor the else chain; a future edit may desync the two conditions.
recommended_fix: Merge into one if/else-if/else chain (swallow handling inside the first branch).

title: Key collection buffer grew to 10 but 13 keys can now arrive in one frame; extras drop silently
detail: Possible collected keys: P,Space,U,A,E,M,S,Up,Down,Left,Right,Enter,Esc = 13; buffer is 10, overflow keys vanish with no log.
recommended_fix: Size the array to the actual key count (13) or assert/log on overflow.
